DASH_DESCRIPTION: Sales, purchases, and payments for your selected period.
DASH_DATES_HELP: Dates use your local timezone. Weeks start on Monday. Custom ranges include both dates. Activity is counted by its original transaction date; customer links reflect current assignments.
DASH_INVALID: Choose valid dates with the end on or after the start.
DASH_ERROR: Unable to load the dashboard. Try refreshing.
DASH_SALES_HELP: Saved sale totals after discounts. Customer payments are excluded.
DASH_PAYMENTS_HELP: Recorded customer payments only. Sales are not assumed to have been paid.
DASH_CUSTOMERS_HELP: Distinct linked customers with a sale or customer payment in this period.
DASH_MOVEMENT_HELP: Linked sales minus customer payments in this period. A negative amount reduces what customers owe. This is not the all-time outstanding balance.
DASH_TREND: Sales and Customer Payments Over Time
DASH_TREND_HELP: Activity by day or month. Periods without activity are omitted.
DASH_BALANCES_HELP: Current balances across all dates. Select a customer to view their history. Negative balances are customer credit. Settled includes customers with no transactions.
DASH_TOP_ITEMS_HELP: Selected period only. Rank by units or item value using the price at the time of each sale. Item values are before order discounts, so they may differ from the sales total.
DASH_NO_ITEMS: No items sold in this period.
DASH_VIEW_BALANCES: View Customer Balances and Customer Payments
BACKUP_ARCHIVE_INVALID: Choose a complete POS ZIP backup. Its manifest and table files must be intact.
PWA_BACKUP_RECOMMENDATION: We recommend downloading a database backup before updating, especially when a new version changes how data is stored. You can restore the backup if you need it later.
PWA_BACKUP_WORKSPACE: The backup includes the current ${workspace} workspace. Other workspaces and display/language settings are separate.
PWA_UPDATE_UNSAVED: Finish or discard any unposted sale first. Updating reloads the app and may upgrade its database. Downloading a backup does not start the update.
PWA_BACKUP_CHECK_DOWNLOAD: Backup download started. Check that the ZIP is saved before choosing Update App.
RESET_DESCRIPTION: Erase all saved records in the workspace you are currently using. This cannot be undone without a backup.
RESET_TARGET: You are about to erase every record in database ${database}.
RESET_CONTENTS: This deletes all contacts, items, stock counts, sales, purchases, customer payments, supplier payments, discounts, price history, links and summaries.
RESET_SCOPE: Only the current workspace is erased. The other real/demo workspace, app settings, language files and downloaded backups are kept. The database structure stays ready for new data.
RESET_BACKUP_ADVICE: Download a ZIP backup first and check that it saved. You can restore it from Database Backup later.
RESET_OTHER_TABS: Close other POS tabs or windows first. After erasing, reload the app to discard any unsaved order and start fresh.
RESET_TYPE_NAME: To continue, type the database name exactly: ${database}
RESET_FINAL: Final confirmation: permanently erase ALL records in ${database}? You will need a saved backup to recover them.
RESET_DONE: All records in ${database} were erased. Reload the app to start fresh.
RESET_NAME_MISMATCH: The database name does not match. Nothing was erased.
RESET_FAILED: The database could not be cleared. The reset was not completed.
REPORT_DASHBOARD_HELP: Sales, customer payments, supplier transactions, and items sold for the selected period.
REPORT_NO_PAYMENTS: No customer payments in this period.
STOCK_ENABLE_HELP: Show current stock on Items and in the item picker. Posted sales reduce stock only while enabled. Existing items start at zero until you set their counts; past sales are not deducted again.
STOCK_FORCE_HELP: Block adding, increasing quantities or posting when there is not enough stock. Requires stock management. When off, warn and continue; counts may go below zero.
STOCK_EDIT_HELP: Enter the actual number currently available. This replaces the stock count; it does not add to it. Stock changes do not change past sales.
STOCK_INVALID: Enter a nonnegative stock count with up to 3 decimal places.
STOCK_SAVE_FAILED: Stock could not be saved. Try again.
STOCK_ALREADY_POSTED: This sale is already saved. Stock was not deducted again.
DELETED_SETTING_HELP: Show Active Only / Include Deleted controls in lists and reports. Turning this off hides deleted records in lists; historical sale details still show their original items.
DELETE_SOFT_WARNING: Delete ${name}? It will be hidden from normal lists and new selections, but its saved history stays in the database.
DELETE_SALE_WARNING: Delete transaction ${name}? It will no longer count in reports, customer transaction counts or customer balances, even if linked to a customer. The stored transaction and links are retained. Include Deleted can show them for historical review.
DELETE_HARD_WARNING: Permanently delete ${name}? This removes stored records and cannot be undone without a backup. Download a backup first.
DELETE_ITEM_CASCADE: This permanently deletes the item, its stock and price history, and EVERY sale or purchase containing it, including all their lines and links. Account balances and reports will change. Historical records will be lost.
DELETE_CUSTOMER_CASCADE: This permanently deletes the contact and EVERY currently linked sale, purchase and payment, including their lines and links. Account balances and reports will change. Historical records will be lost.
DELETE_TRANSACTION_CASCADE: The transaction, its product/discount lines and customer links will be permanently removed. Customer summaries and reports will be recalculated.
DELETE_STOCK_NOTE: Recorded stock deductions are reversed once. Sales saved before stock-deduction tracking was added may need a manual stock correction.
DELETE_TYPE: Type ${name} exactly to confirm permanent deletion.
DELETE_FAILED: The deletion could not be completed. No partial deletion was saved.
DELETE_STALE: The record is missing or has changed. Refresh before trying again.
DELETE_INVALID_METADATA: The backup has invalid deletion or stock-tracking metadata.
UNLINK_DESCRIPTION: Remove this transaction from ${customer}’s account? Their transaction count, balance and latest activity will be recalculated. The transaction stays saved in history and stock is unchanged. You can link it to a customer again later.
UNLINK_PAYMENT_NOTE: Unlinking a sale reduces the customer’s balance due. Unlinking a payment removes that credit and may increase what they owe. Deleted transactions already excluded from balances stay excluded.
UNLINK_FAILED: The customer could not be unlinked. No partial changes were saved.
UNLINK_CHANGED: This transaction’s customer link has changed. Refresh the page before trying again.
PRINT_HELP: Print all matching rows for this report. Choose Save as PDF in the print dialog.
PRINT_FAILED: The report could not be prepared for printing. Try again.
PRINT_ACTIVE_ONLY: Soft-deleted transactions and customers are excluded. Historical item details are retained.
PRINT_FOOTER: ${SOFTWARE_NAME} report · All matching records are included, regardless of the on-screen page size.
PRINT_BALANCE_FILTERS: Balance filter: ${status}. Search: ${search}. These balances are current and all-time, not limited to a report period.
RESTORE_VERIFYING: Writes finished. Checking the saved record counts…
RESTORE_KEEP_OPEN: Keep this app open and in the foreground until completion. Large restores can take several minutes.
RESTORE_INTERRUPTED: A previous restore did not report completion, possibly because the app closed. Check your records before continuing. If the backup was not applied, select the ZIP again and retry while keeping the app open.
RESTORE_QUOTA: There is not enough browser storage to finish restoring. The replacement was rolled back; the previous database was kept. Free storage and try again.
RESTORE_VERIFY_FAILED: The restore committed, but its saved counts could not be confirmed. Reload and check your data before attempting another restore.
EXPORT_KEEP_OPEN: Keep the app open while the backup is prepared. Your browser will handle saving the ZIP when it is ready.
BUY_ENABLE_HELP: Record purchases and supplier payments using shared Contacts. Receiving a purchase adds stock only when stock management is enabled.
BUY_DESCRIPTION: Receive goods, record what you paid and track what you owe each supplier.
BUY_DISABLED: Enable Purchasing in Settings to use this section. Existing purchasing records are kept when disabled.
BUY_RECEIVE_HELP: Saving receives these goods. Costs belong to this purchase and never change selling prices. Stock increases only while stock management is enabled.
BUY_INVALID: Check the contact, date, quantities and costs. Quantities allow up to 3 decimal places; money allows up to 2.
BUY_SAVE_FAILED: The purchase or payment could not be saved. No partial changes were saved.
CONTACT_BALANCE_HELP: Current all-time balances are separate. Positive amounts are owed; negative amounts are advance credit. Sales and purchases are never automatically offset.
BUY_DELETE_WARNING: Delete ${name}? It will no longer count in supplier balances or purchasing history. Recorded stock receipts will be reversed once; stock may become negative if the goods have already been sold. Supplier payment deletion changes the balance only.
BUY_HARD_WARNING: This permanently removes the purchasing record and its purchase lines. Supplier balances change. Recorded stock effects are reversed only once.
CONTACT_ROLE_HELP: One contact can buy from you and supply goods to you. Open a contact to view the two accounts separately.
ORDER_MODE_HELP: Sale and Purchase keep separate drafts until posted or cleared.
ORDER_BUY_COST_HELP: Enter the agreed buying cost for this purchase. Selling prices stay unchanged.
ORDER_PURCHASE_HELP: Add everything received from one supplier, set buying costs and quantities, then post the whole purchase.
ORDER_CLEAR_PURCHASE: Clear all items in this purchase draft? Nothing has been saved or added to stock yet.
DASH_SUPPLIER_MOVEMENT_HELP: Purchases minus supplier payments in this period. This is a change in debt, not the total outstanding balance.
SUPPLIER_INSIGHTS_HELP: Rankings and averages follow the selected period. Current balances include all recorded purchases and payments.
SUPPLIER_ALL_TIME: All recorded activity, regardless of the selected period.
SUPPLIER_TOP_HELP: Ranked by purchase value in the selected period. Payments may settle earlier purchases.
SUPPLIER_BALANCES_HELP: Positive balances are amounts you owe; negative balances are supplier credit. These balances include all time.
LOCALE_AUDIT_HELP: Check missing or empty text in each language, including pages you have not opened. Missing text falls back to English, then to the key itself. Custom files may intentionally use English for omitted entries.
LOCALE_AUDIT_NO_MATCHES: No missing translations match this search
PRINT_PDF_MOBILE_HELP: Share the PDF to print it or save it to Files. You can also download or open it.
PRINT_PDF_SHARE_FAILED: Sharing was unavailable. Try Download PDF or Open PDF.
